templates.why_chosen: A textbook hub-spoke: Conveyor Core's shared database sits at the centre with circled steps 1-7 radiating out to Release Creator, Run Scheduler and Run Manager, plus two dashed pluggable-service groups as sub-spokes.
templates.what_to_learn: Number every arrow touching the hub in one continuous sequence (1-7) so a reader can replay one full request cycle through a database-centred hub, and group interchangeable plug-ins (Artifact Finders, Action Services) in a dashed box; this exemplar's own weakness is skipping a legend for its dashed-vs-solid convention.

templates.why_chosen: High-confidence, 13-component exemplar with a numbered 7-step path through the Conveyor Core hub, flanked by two dashed pill-columns of interchangeable plug-ins, Artifact Finders on one side and Action Services on the other.
templates.what_to_learn: Draw each side column as a dashed group box containing named interchangeable plug-ins (finders, action services) rather than one generic label, and number the full request path across both wings so a reader can follow create-then-run without a separate legend; add a legend anyway once box types multiply beyond dashed-versus-solid.
